name: Tract Shape Analysis
summary: Computes tract shape measures (length, span, area, volume, elongation, curvature, torsion and more) for each tract in a tcks folder with DSI Studio and DIPY and merges them into one tractmeasures CSV.
description: Converts each .tck to .trk using a reference image, computes geometric shape statistics with DSI Studio and curvature/torsion with DIPY, and stacks and merges them into stat/tractmeasures.csv. Only one reference image is needed: the first available of T1w, T2w, parcellation or mask is used. Use it to characterise tract morphology for group analyses.

inputs.requirements: Must contain at least one .tck file.

inputs.description: T1-weighted reference image (used first if present).
T2-weighted reference image (used if no T1w is given).
Mask used as reference image if no anatomical image is given.
Parcellation used as reference image if no anatomical image is given.

outputs.description: Tract measures table (tractmeasures.csv) with one row per tract and DSI Studio and DIPY shape metrics.

failure_modes.message: Error: no .tck files found in directory
failure_modes.fix: Provide a tcks dataset containing .tck files.
